releaseNotes: V1012 normalizes Device Scene Line thickness editing by wiring the existing schema-v5 StrokeWidth property to immediate Canvas preview while preserving Save Properties as the permanent Scene SSOT commit boundary.

Pipe Flow now reuses the existing FillHex, StrokeHex, StrokeWidth, Opacity and animation path for a more industrial pipe presentation. Existing Fresh/range-valid/non-zero flow renders with the existing process-blue theme resource, while stop/disconnected/bad-quality states remain static and neutral.

No new Pipe topology, shader, animation subsystem, write/control API or schema field was introduced. Resize/rotation, Web V1011 synchronization, communication/runtime, authority and AI paths remain outside this patch.

en: Line Stroke Width now previews immediately on the Canvas and is permanently stored only through Save Properties using the existing schema-v5 property.
Pipe Flow reuses the existing animation path: only Fresh, range-valid, non-zero SSOT flow is shown in process Water Blue; stop/disconnected states remain neutral and static.
ko: Line Stroke Width는 기존 Schema v5 속성을 그대로 사용하며 Canvas에 즉시 Preview되고, Save Properties 실행 시에만 Scene SSOT에 영구 저장됩니다.
Pipe Flow는 기존 애니메이션 경로만 재사용하며 Fresh + 유효 범위 + 0보다 큰 SSOT 흐름일 때만 Water Blue 계열로 표시되고 정지/연결 해제 상태는 중립 정적 표현을 유지합니다.
ja: Line の Stroke Width は既存の Schema v5 プロパティをそのまま使用し、Canvas に即時プレビューされ、Save Properties 実行時のみ Scene SSOT に永続保存されます。
Pipe Flow は既存のアニメーション経路のみを再利用し、Fresh・有効レンジ・0 より大きい SSOT フローの場合だけ Water Blue 系で表示し、停止・切断状態ではニュートラルな静止表示を維持します。
zh-CN: Line 的 Stroke Width 继续使用现有 Schema v5 属性，可在 Canvas 上即时预览，并且仅在执行 Save Properties 时永久保存到 Scene SSOT。
Pipe Flow 仅复用现有动画路径；只有 Fresh、量程有效且 SSOT 流量大于 0 时才显示 Water Blue 流动效果，停止或断开连接时保持中性静态显示。
de: Die Stroke Width einer Line verwendet weiterhin die vorhandene Schema-v5-Eigenschaft, wird sofort auf dem Canvas vorab angezeigt und erst mit Save Properties dauerhaft im Scene-SSOT gespeichert.

Pipe Flow verwendet ausschließlich den vorhandenen Animationspfad: Nur bei Fresh, gültigem Bereich und einem SSOT-Fluss größer als 0 wird Water Blue dargestellt; Stop/Disconnect bleiben neutral und statisch.
es: Stroke Width de Line reutiliza la propiedad existente de Schema v5, se previsualiza inmediatamente en el Canvas y solo se guarda de forma permanente en el Scene SSOT mediante Save Properties.

Pipe Flow reutiliza únicamente la ruta de animación existente: el flujo SSOT Fresh, con rango válido y mayor que 0 se muestra en Water Blue; los estados Stop/Disconnected permanecen neutros y estáticos.
